scoring_gate.selection: maximize dev reference hits minus non-reference displays; tie: hits, stricter gate

source_selection.source: pinned UD Chinese GSDSimp test corpus

edits: every fourth positive externally replaces the next source prefix with this prefix
chains: all seeds including negatives, all three methods, first candidate, at most three acknowledged append steps within 1000 ms per step; include zero-length and failed chains
quality_acceptance: reproducible paired metrics and explicit unsuitable conclusion are acceptable; no requirement to improve accuracy or hide stopped chains
review: blind candidate/chain sheets, two independent human reviewers and third-person adjudication protocol; assistant annotations are labeled separately and never counted as human votes
freeze_note: Original Q4_K_M/v1 prompt, grammar, greedy decoding and confidence gate remain frozen. Compact-JSON and Q4_0 experiments were rejected using authored development probes only. JSON framing speculation was rejected by output-equivalence testing and removed. Final runtime uses only public prompt preparation and exact ranked grammar filtering. No inference has yet been run on the offset-24 holdout.
